correctness.rationale: For any finite field F_q and n≥2, Fourier of the graph (X,Y,XY+YX) sums first over Y, enforcing S_C(X)=CX+XC=−B. The trace-adjoint of S_C equals S_C, hence the affine-fibre character sum is nonzero iff A,B∈im S_C and has magnitude q^{N+ν(C)}. Represent V_C as an F_q[t]-module; ker S_C=Hom(V_{−C},V_C) has dimension sum_f deg(f)〈λ_f,λ_{f⁻}〉. Centralizer-group counts indexed by rational canonical partitions yield the complete negation-paired generating product Z_q and rank q^{2N}|GL_n|[u^n]Z_q(u,q^{−2}). Odd char C=I gives ν=0; in char2 S_C is a commutator and ν≥n with equality on cyclic C; ν=N at C=0. Schwartz–Zippel of det S_C yields odd density tending one for fixed n, while even density ≤q^{−2n}. Independent exact finite-field n=2 rank histograms at q=2,3,5 matched the stated tables and singular-value bounds.

evidence: Chen–Wang §2 treats anti-layered Jordan blocks for AB+BA=0 over C, and §4 geometry of anti-commuting varieties; the published commutator graph has full all-n centralizer spectrum.

evidence: For odd q, S_I=2I gives support all pairs for at least one C, unlike ad_C which has scalar kernel dimension n². For even q S_C=ad_C.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: These opposite support behaviors demonstrate that commutator theorem does not dominate all-characteristic Jordan graph; Chen–Wang gives anti-commuting pairs but not the full additive convolution law.

originality.rationale: The published finite-field commutator-graph theorem uses ad_C(X)=CX−XC, with centralizer Euler product and all frequencies, but this Jordan anticommutator graph differs in odd characteristic and requires coupled f↔f⁻ rational-canonical partitions. In characteristic two it specializes to the prior commutator case, which is not claimed new.
residual_risks: An unlocated general Fourier theory of bilinear graphs may subsume the image criterion as a standard consequence.
A prior weighted anticommuting module partition enumerator might already determine the coupled negation-orbit Euler product.

value.rationale: The odd/even characteristic dichotomy in full Fourier support, sharp supported condition numbers, and complete mixed-negation-primary singular multiplicities of a natural matrix Jordan-product graph form a nontrivial structural harmonic classification, distinct from the known commutator case.
